violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE ANOTHER STAFF MEMBER OBTAINS A CERTIFICATION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED GRILLED CHICKEN AT 45F, SOUR CREAM AT 45F, MILK AT 48-49F, AND COJITA CHEESE AT 48F IN THE 1-DOOR MAXX COLD UPR IN THE MAIN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED ALL FOOD ITEMS AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO COLD HOLD UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 1-DOOR MAXX COLD UPR COOLER AT 42F WITH INTERNAL THERMOMETER (DIGITAL THERMOMETER READ AT 36F).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE FROM THIS COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO COLD HOLD FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE THE COOLER IS REPAIRED/ADJUSTED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. EHS ALSO RECOMMENDS KEEPING LESS PRODUCT IN THIS COOLER TO ALLOW FOR BETTER AIR CIRCULATION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS HOSE SHOULD BE HUNG UP WHEN NOT IN USE TO PREVENT BACK-FLOW ISSUE. PLEASE ENSURE A SHORTER HOSE INSTALLED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION AS A PERMANENT FIX.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink. OBSERVED HOSE HUNG UP AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION, BUT PRE-SCRAPE HOSE DOES EXTEND PASS THE FLOOD LEVEL RIM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE PRE-SCRAPE HOSE AT THE THREE VAT SINK MUST ALWAYS BE HUNG UP TO PREVENT A BACKFLOW ISSUE. HOSE SHOULD BE SHORTENED EVENTUALLY TO ELIMINATE THIS ISSUE.
